reuse.why: Reuses findOrCreateBank and shares linking, transaction downloading, holder lookup, and local unlinking across existing and new consumers.

duplication.why: Removes substantial provider duplication while retaining thin adapters for provider-specific inputs.

placement.why: Account orchestration, transaction transport, server configuration, and provider types remain in their established layers.

scope.why: The refactoring and supporting type, configuration, client compatibility, and test changes directly support the requested linking features.

maintainability.why: Shared operations simplify maintenance, although separating validation into registration wrappers requires keeping provider identities aligned with the adapters.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers use the shared checks and linking implementation, and replacement and ordinary unlinking share clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The provider implementations are consolidated into shared functions rather than renamed or reshaped copies.

abstraction_drift.where: downloadBankSyncTransactions adds providerName and serverUrl; shared linking adds replaceExistingLink, with flag-controlled branches in withBankAccountLinkCheck and linkBankSyncAccount; no consumers bypass the shared implementations.
